theme: Ugin & Nicol Bolas - Elder Dragon Duality (Phase 6 Pilot 1)
status: UNAPPROVED PROPOSAL - awaiting Cory's review; not approved, not locked, not certified

tier_definitions.DIRECT_DEPICTION: Official Wizards story captions this exact art at the event, or Pack A4 exact-art scene match.
tier_definitions.CANON_REFERENCE: Card is the character/object/event, or its printed text or an official article ties it to Ugin/Bolas canon.
tier_definitions.LORE_INSPIRED: Named or thematic link only; no scene or event asserted.
tier_definitions.MECHANICAL_SYMBOL: Included for function; no story claim.

cards.name: Nicol Bolas, the Ravager // Nicol Bolas, the Arisen
cards.beat: commander
cards.why: Grixis Elder Dragon commander; transforms into the Arisen. Ugin is colourless and lives in the 99.

printing.type_line: Legendary Creature — Elder Dragon // Legendary Planeswalker — Bolas

cards.name: Nicol Bolas
cards.beat: I. Twin Elder Dragons of Dominaria and the Elder Dragon War
cards.why: The original Elder Dragon card; printed flavor 'Dominaria's most ancient evil.' Bolas and Ugin hatched as twins on Dominaria.

printing.printed_flavor: Dominaria's most ancient evil.

cards.name: The Elder Dragon War
cards.beat: I. Twin Elder Dragons of Dominaria and the Elder Dragon War
cards.why: Names the war Bolas instigated among the elder dragons. Not certified as a literal battlefield reconstruction.

cards.name: Crosis, the Purger
cards.beat: I. Twin Elder Dragons of Dominaria and the Elder Dragon War
cards.why: Grixis-coloured primeval descendant of the elder dragon lineage (Piru line, Pack A2).

cards.name: Ghostfire
cards.beat: I. Twin Elder Dragons of Dominaria and the Elder Dragon War
cards.why: Printed flavor: only those gifted with the eye of Ugin, the spirit dragon, can see his fiery breath. Colourless red spell.

printing.printed_flavor: Only those gifted with the eye of Ugin, the spirit dragon, can see his fiery breath.

cards.name: Fraying Omnipotence
cards.beat: I. Twin Elder Dragons of Dominaria and the Elder Dragon War
cards.why: Printed flavor: the Mending unravelled Nicol Bolas's power. Bridges the ancient god-like Bolas to the post-Mending schemer.

printing.printed_flavor: The Great Mending that healed the Multiverse also unraveled the threads of Nicol Bolas's power.

cards.name: Nicol Bolas, Planeswalker
cards.beat: II. Alara: the Conflux scheme
cards.why: Pack A4 exact-art match (NAMED_CHARACTER_ART_IN_STORY): the Bolas portrait used in the Ugin/Bolas duel coverage.

cards.name: Slave of Bolas
cards.beat: II. Alara: the Conflux scheme
cards.why: Named after Bolas; flavor: Bolas does not distinguish servants and victims.

printing.printed_flavor: Nicol Bolas doesn't distinguish between servants and victims.

cards.name: Soul Manipulation
cards.beat: II. Alara: the Conflux scheme
cards.why: Printed Nicol Bolas quote; Grixis counter/recursion of the Conflux era.

printing.printed_flavor:
"Birth and death are both reversible."
—Nicol Bolas

cards.name: Countersquall
cards.beat: II. Alara: the Conflux scheme
cards.why: Duel Decks: Ajani vs. Nicol Bolas printing; flavor states Bolas's creed of power.

printing.printed_flavor:
"The essence of every world, every spell, and every thought is power. Nothing else matters, because nothing else exists."
—Nicol Bolas

cards.name: Mana Drain
cards.beat: II. Alara: the Conflux scheme
cards.why: Judge printing with a Nicol Bolas quote: 'Power is wasted on the weak.' Not a Game Changer.

printing.printed_flavor:
"Power is wasted on the weak. They never keep it for long."
—Nicol Bolas

cards.name: Magmaquake
cards.beat: II. Alara: the Conflux scheme
cards.why: Printed Nicol Bolas threat; the M13 Bolas planeswalker-deck era.

printing.printed_flavor:
"Where will you run when I punish you with the very ground you flee on?"
—Nicol Bolas

cards.name: Augur of Bolas
cards.beat: II. Alara: the Conflux scheme
cards.why: War of the Spark printing: 'There is no future save the one my master wills.'

printing.printed_flavor: "There is no future save the one my master wills."

cards.name: Disciple of Bolas
cards.beat: II. Alara: the Conflux scheme
cards.why: Printed 'Lord Bolas' quote; sacrifice-for-cards servant.

printing.printed_flavor: "Lord Bolas has shown me how each miserable little life holds untold resources."

cards.name: Hedron Archive
cards.beat: III. Zendikar: Ugin's hedrons and the Eldrazi prison
cards.why: Printed Ugin dialogue about the hedrons' true purpose.

printing.printed_flavor: "You've begun to understand the hedrons' true purpose," said Ugin. "The Eldrazi can be imprisoned.""And how did that work out last time?" asked Jace.

cards.name: Perilous Vault
cards.beat: III. Zendikar: Ugin's hedrons and the Eldrazi prison
cards.why: Printed flavor: Ugin arranged Zendikar's hedrons to direct leylines.

printing.printed_flavor: The spirit dragon Ugin arranged the hedrons of Zendikar to direct leylines of energy. To disrupt one is to unleash devastation and chaos.

cards.name: Ugin's Insight
cards.beat: III. Zendikar: Ugin's hedrons and the Eldrazi prison
cards.why: Printed Ugin quote on the three Eldrazi titans.

printing.printed_flavor:
"You speak to me of the threat of Ulamog. But do not forget: they came as three."
—Ugin, to Jace Beleren

cards.name: Dispel
cards.beat: III. Zendikar: Ugin's hedrons and the Eldrazi prison
cards.why: BFZ printing contrasting Ugin's stasis plan with destruction of the Eldrazi.

printing.printed_flavor:
"I said we should destroy the Eldrazi. Ugin wanted to return them to stasis. Ugin's arguments were . . . unconvincing."
—Jace Beleren

cards.name: Ugin's Binding
cards.beat: III. Zendikar: Ugin's hedrons and the Eldrazi prison
cards.why: Named Ugin binding magic (devoid, colourless spell for Ugin, Eye of the Storms). Card name only; no scene claimed.

cards.name: Crux of Fate
cards.beat: IV. Tarkir: the duel, the fall, and the reforged timeline
cards.why: Pack A4 exact-art match: official story art caption of the Ugin-Bolas battle.

printing.printed_flavor: Ugin's whispered summons led Sarkhan Vol to the moment that would echo down the centuries and seal Tarkir's fate: the primal battle between Ugin and Nicol Bolas.

cards.name: Ugin's Nexus
cards.beat: IV. Tarkir: the duel, the fall, and the reforged timeline
cards.why: Pack A4: official story device (the nexus Sarkhan uses to reach the past).

printing.printed_flavor: All at once Sarkhan's mind fell silent.

cards.name: Ugin, the Spirit Dragon
cards.beat: IV. Tarkir: the duel, the fall, and the reforged timeline
cards.why: Pack A4 exact Raymond Swanland art (not the ugin/1 promo art). Ugin survives in the reforged timeline.

cards.name: Bitter Revelation
cards.beat: IV. Tarkir: the duel, the fall, and the reforged timeline
cards.why: Printed Sorin quote at Ugin's tomb in the original Khans timeline.

printing.printed_flavor:
"Here you lie then, Ugin. The corpses of worlds will join you in the tomb."
—Sorin Markov

cards.name: Witness of the Ages
cards.beat: IV. Tarkir: the duel, the fall, and the reforged timeline
cards.why: Printed flavor: it strode through the clash of dragons and the fall of Ugin.

printing.printed_flavor: It strode through the clash of dragons, the fall of Ugin, and the rise of the khans.

cards.name: Fearsome Awakening
cards.beat: IV. Tarkir: the duel, the fall, and the reforged timeline
cards.why: Fate Reforged printing tying the dragon tempests to Ugin; reanimates a dragon.

printing.printed_flavor: On Tarkir, dragons emerge from enormous tempests, phenomena tied to Ugin's very presence on the plane.

cards.name: Sarkhan the Mad
cards.beat: IV. Tarkir: the duel, the fall, and the reforged timeline
cards.why: Official profile: Sarkhan swore fealty to Bolas and went mad before returning to Tarkir.

cards.name: Sarkhan, the Dragonspeaker
cards.beat: IV. Tarkir: the duel, the fall, and the reforged timeline
cards.why: Official profile: Sarkhan travelled back and saved Ugin from death at Bolas's hands.

cards.name: Dragonlord Silumgar
cards.beat: IV. Tarkir: the duel, the fall, and the reforged timeline
cards.why: Official Tarkir page: Ugin's survival produced the dragonlord timeline; Silumgar is the Grixis-adjacent UB dragonlord.

printing.printed_flavor: Silumgar never passes up an opportunity to add to his opulence.

cards.name: Dragonlord Kolaghan
cards.beat: IV. Tarkir: the duel, the fall, and the reforged timeline
cards.why: Same consequence; Kolaghan is the BR dragonlord.

cards.name: Hour of Devastation

printing.printed_flavor:
"Everything here exists or perishes at my whim. Including you, Gatewatch."
—Nicol Bolas

cards.name: Jace's Defeat
cards.beat: V. Amonkhet: the God-Pharaoh and the Hour of Devastation
cards.why: Captioned in the official story as Bolas crushes Jace's mind.

printing.printed_flavor:

—Nicol Bolas

—Nicol Bolas

cards.name: Ugin, the Ineffable

cards.name: Sarkhan's Catharsis
cards.beat: VI. War of the Spark: the Elderspell, the fall, the prison
cards.why: Printed Sarkhan quote turning on Bolas.

printing.printed_flavor: "You once brought havoc to my home and ruined my mind. I'm here to return the favor, Bolas."

cards.name: No Escape
cards.beat: VI. War of the Spark: the Elderspell, the fall, the prison
cards.why: Printed flavor: Jace surmised they were walking into Bolas's trap.

printing.printed_flavor: Jace surmised that they were walking into Bolas's trap. He felt no joy in being right.

cards.name: Ugin, Eye of the Storms
cards.beat: VII. Tarkir Dragonstorm: Ugin's later fate
cards.why: Ugin in the Dragonstorm era. A011 (his status afterwards) remains OPEN_QUESTION.

cards.name: Dracogenesis
cards.beat: VII. Tarkir Dragonstorm: Ugin's later fate
cards.why: Showcase printing chosen for its Ugin flavor: the dragonstorms weakened with his death and raged with his life.

printing.printed_flavor: Ugin and the dragonstorms of Tarkir are intrinsically linked. With his death they weakened. With his life they raged. But even the Spirit Dragon does not hold them fully under his sway.

cards.name: Watcher of the Wayside
cards.beat: VII. Tarkir Dragonstorm: Ugin's later fate
cards.why: Printed flavor: the golem survived dragonlords, khans and Ugin himself.

printing.printed_flavor: Against dragonlords, khans, and Ugin himself, the golem survived. Original purpose forgotten, it awaits orders that will never come, from a world that has moved on without it.

cards.name: Tomb of the Spirit Dragon
cards.beat: story lands
cards.why: Pack A4 STORY_LOCATION_ART_CAPTION: Ugin's tomb in the original timeline.

printing.printed_flavor:
"The voice calls me here, yet I see only bones. Is this more dragon trickery?"
—Sarkhan Vol
